samples.name: wheel update through two animation frames

checks.name: One footprint release retains unchanged render groups and stays below 50 ms p95
Mounted scene scales with visible area while the full saved layout remains intact
Native Stage pan reveals new objects before release and writes the saved viewport only once
Selection and a trace crossing the entire viewport survive culling; hidden copper remains hidden
Cached pad hit targets route between visible endpoints with the starting footprint offscreen
Copper and silkscreen visibility are independent, including cached pad hit testing
Distant zoom reduces labels while keeping pads and the complete physical layout
Via dragging commits snapped coordinates without changing the viewport
Read-only mode prevents pad routing and late footprint/via drag writes
An active footprint or via stays mounted when a viewport change crosses its stored bounds
Rotated cached pads use physical world coordinates, and renaming/selection refresh cached content
Cache buffers stay bounded and release on scene detach; reload retains all offscreen manufacturing geometry
60-second production pan, zoom and routing window meets the 50 ms stress draw budget

conditions: Actual PCB scene; installed headless Chrome at 1366x800; external HTTP blocked.
Twenty load-separated and forty warm actual mouse releases. Latency starts before Konva capture-phase mouseup and ends at ratline-layer draw; physical display scanout is not measured.
Mixed board contains 1024 footprints, 1025 traces and 1024 vias. React render-call counters are test-only. Wheel windows include automation/two-frame pacing and are not input-to-paint.
metadataCorrection: Sample-count wording and combined footprint/trace cache label corrected to match the existing instrumentation. Raw observations, timestamps, assertions and status unchanged.
